name: Room
description: Rooms and interior spaces for buildings or dungeons

fields.description: bed, chest, washstand, personal keepsakes, and evidence of the occupant's last activity.
worn seating around a hearth with family objects and a concealed letter.
preparation tables, ovens, knives, stored food, and something recently left cooking.
long tables, serving doors, faded decoration, and seating arranged by status.
basic sanitation, a narrow vent, cleaning supplies, and graffiti from previous users.
shelves of preserved food with one wall sounding hollow when struck.
labeled crates, spare furniture, dust, and one object that clearly does not belong: {{ curio.name }}.
desk, correspondence, account books, locked drawers, and an appointment calendar.
specialized tools, unfinished work, material scraps, and a dangerous active device.
weapon racks, duty roster, cards, half-eaten meals, and an alarm mechanism.
restraints, scratched messages, stale water, and signs of an impossible escape.
packed shelves, reading desks, ladders, catalogues, and a deliberately misfiled book.
stained benches, fragile instruments, sealed samples, and an experiment still progressing.
maintained weapons, including {{ weapons.name }}; armor stands, issue records, and several conspicuous empty spaces.
narrow beds, medical tools, a treatment under study for {{ affliction.name }}, and patient notes written in code.
benches, sacred images, and offerings dedicated to {{ religion.name }}, plus a small private confessional passage.
heated pool, drains, towels, privacy screens, and access to maintenance tunnels.
small beds, toys, lesson boards, and protective symbols painted beneath the furniture.
polished floor, musicians' gallery, chandeliers, and balconies designed for observation.
wall maps, surveying tools, campaign markers, and one region intentionally erased.
counted valuables, including {{ valuables.name }}; sealed chests, ownership records, and multiple layers of security.
a cramped route with spy holes, old footprints, and a mechanism opening elsewhere.
geometric markings, restraints, consumed offerings, and lingering supernatural pressure.
a reinforced chamber centered on an inactive gate and emergency shutdown controls.
preserved beasts, captured banners, a named weapon such as {{ weapons.name }}, and one display that is still alive.
fixed chair, soundproof walls, drainage channel, and carefully organized questions.
